b) The respondent/JD/husband shall pay a sum of Rs. 8,00,000/-
(Rupees Eight Lakhs only) to the complainant/DH/wife towards full and final settlement of all her claims regarding permanent alimony, stridhan and maintenance (past, present and future).
c) The settled sum of Rs. 8,00,000/- (Rupees Eight Lakhs only) shall be paid by the respondent/JD/husband to the complainant/DH/wife in three installments as under:
i) First installment of Rs. 3,00,000/- (Rupees Three Lakhs only) shall be paid by the respondent/husband to the complainant/DH/wife by way of DD, at the time of recording of their joint statement in the first motion petition u/s 13-B (1) of HMA,
which shall be jointly filled by them within one month from the date of signing of the present settlement.

ii) Second installment of Rs. 3,00,000/-(Rupees Three Lakhs only) shall be paid by the respondent/husband to the complainant/wife at the time of recording of their joint statement in the second motion petition u/s 13-B (2) of HMA.
Both the parties shall move second motion petition for divorce within fifteen days of expiry of the minimum statutory period or any time sooner as per law.

iii) Third installment of Rs. 2,00,000/- (Rupees Two Lakhs only) shall be paid by the respondent/husband/JD to the complainant/wife/DH at the time of quashing of FIR No. 612/19, u/s 498A/406/34 IPC PS Najafgarh, before the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi.
The respondents shall move appropriate petition for quashing of above said FIR before the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi which shall be filed within one month from the date of decree of divorce.
The complainant/DH/wife undertakes to appear before the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi and cooperate in the said proceedings.

6. The complainant/DH/wife shall withdraw the present execution petition and the above-mentioned connected case mentioned at Sr. no. 1 and 3 in the list of connected cases, within a week after recording of statement in the first motion petition u/s 13-B (1) of HMA.
Neutral Citation Number 2023:DHC:4834 7.

It is agreed between the parties that if the complainant/wife/DH violates the terms and conditions of this settlement, then the complainant/wife/DH shall refund double the amount paid by respondent/husband/JD to her and if the respondent/husband/JD violates the terms and conditions of this settlement, then the amount already paid by the respondent/JD/husband to complainant/DH/wife shall be forfeited.
